scope: Tighten current work and task summaries
limitations: Headless WebKit with isolated observations. Native OS input, assistive technology and Rust command integration were not exercised.

work--blocked-task-compact-dark.png.task: Inspect an execution and its tasks using aligned state and fact rows.
work--blocked-task-compact-dark.png.observations: The objective and started date form a compact header. Completed and Blocked badges are distinct; the complete signing-certificate blocker is readable in the compact opening view. Task numbering, type and estimate align below each title.

work--plan-compact-dark.png.task: Inspect an execution and its tasks using aligned state and fact rows.
work--plan-compact-dark.png.observations: The current objective, status and date use a tight hierarchy. Completed, In progress and Planned badges are visually distinct on desktop; the compact opening view shows completed and active task headings, with later task content available by scrolling. No badges overlap titles or metadata.
